([[XY039]]-[[XY137]])| }} '''Sophie''' (Japanese: '''ソフィ''' ''Sophie'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|XY}}. She is one of {{an|Professor Sycamore}}'s assistants. ==History== [[File:Sophie.png|thumb|250px|Sophie (to the right of Cosette)|left]] Sophie first appeared in ''[[XY002|Lumiose City Pursuit!]]''. She was called over by the professor when {{Ash}} arrived with an injured {{AP|Froakie}} and decided to take care of him right away by putting him in a pod. Sophie is known for being an expert in healing Pokémon. Later, {{TRT}} arrived in disguise as scientists, claiming to know about [[Mega Evolution]]. After the lab's {{p|Garchomp}} went out of control due to a collar [[James]] threw at her, Sophie stayed behind in the lab with [[Cosette]]. In ''[[XY003|A Battle of Aerial Mobility!]]'', Sophie presented the three Kalos [[first partner Pokémon]] to {{an|Serena}}, who was about to start on her Pokémon journey. She also briefly appeared in ''[[XY004|A Shockingly Cheeky Friendship!]]'', witnessing how Serena chose {{TP|Serena|Fennekin}} as her [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]]. In ''[[XY010|Mega-Mega Meowth Madness!]]'', Sophie introduced Ash, Serena, {{an|Clemont}}, and {{an|Bonnie}} to a gluttonous {{TP|Clemont|Chespin}} staying in Sycamore's lab. From ''[[XY039|Summer of Discovery!]]'' to ''[[XY042|Battling Into the Hall of Fame!]]'', Sophie was one of the staff at Professor Sycamore's [[Pokémon Summer Camp]]. At the start of the camp, she showed Ash and his friends the cottage where they would be staying for the time being, and told them in which summer camp team they had been put in. Amongst her activities was judging the teams in the various activities. In ''[[XY041|Foggy Pokémon Orienteering!]]'', she waited on the teams at a stamp table in the PokéEnteering competition. Sophie briefly appeared again in ''[[XY068|Garchomp's Mega Bond!]]''. In ''[[XY080|Performing with Fiery Charm!]]'', Sophie watched Serena competing in the [[Dendemille Town]] [[Pokémon Showcase]] alongside Professor Sycamore and Cosette. Sophie briefly appeared again in ''[[XY092|Cloudy Fate, Bright Future!]]'' and ''[[XY093|All Eyes on the Future!]]''. In ''[[XY112|Master Class is in Session!]]'' and ''[[XY113|Performing a Pathway to the Future!]]'', Sophie was watching Serena's performance in the [[Gloire City]] Master Class Pokémon Showcase alongside Professor Sycamore and Cosette. In ''[[XY137|Battling With a Clean Slate!]]'', Sophie handed out medals to Ash, {{ashfr}}, [[Alain]], [[Mairin]], and their Pokémon for their heroic efforts against [[Team Flare]].
